title: Hermes3D Visual Target Manifest
description: W15-A9 schema for visual-targets.json. Describes the W15 visual-oracle harness contract: per-target route, reference PNG, optional viewport / theme / clock / region overrides. The manifest is authored by W15-A8 (visual-target-registry); the harness here in W15-A9 consumes it.

tolerance_default.description: Default maxDiffPixelRatio used when a target omits the `tolerance` field.

reference_viewport.description: Human-readable WxH label for the default reference viewport (e.g. 1536x1024).

target.description: Stable identifier used as the snapshot folder and the reporter row key.

reference.description: Repo-relative path to the reference PNG under Images-GUI/.

route.description: Hash route or full URL to navigate to. Started with / for SPA hash routes.

status.description: live: actively compared; future: registered but skipped (owned by another lane).

wait_test_id.description: data-testid the spec waits for before screenshot. 15s timeout.

viewport.description: W15-A9 cap 2 — per-target viewport override. Falls back to top-level `viewport`.

theme.description: W15-A9 cap 7 — theme key stored in localStorage[h3d.theme] before first paint.

clock_time.description: W15-A9 cap 6 — ISO-8601 timestamp pinned via page.clock.install + pauseAt.

regions.description: W15-A9 caps 1 & 9 — region crops for collage references. Each region produces its own screenshot + diff.

name.description: Region label used as part of the snapshot filename and reporter row.

clip.description: Clip rectangle in CSS pixels passed to page.screenshot({ clip }).

reference.description: Optional per-region reference PNG (under Images-GUI/). Defaults to target.reference.

tolerance.description: Optional per-region tolerance. Defaults to target.tolerance.
